summary: Deceptive package shipping unrelated library code with opaque exported strings
details: Package published as 'fetch-runtime' contains the source of the unrelated 'lines-and-columns' library (README and class both refer to lines-and-columns). It adds two exports, `userAgent` and `fetchEngine`, whose values are long opaque base64-shaped strings that are never decoded, fetched, or executed anywhere in the shipped code. A third export, `markers`, references an undefined symbol and causes `require('fetch-runtime')` to throw. There are no lifecycle hooks, no network calls, no child_process/exec usage, and no filesystem access. Installing or loading this version does not, on its own, exfiltrate data or execute remote code against the installer, but the name/README mismatch, the opaque exported blobs, and the broken export are structurally consistent with a staged or placeholder package.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
